thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager 1: GitHub Actions / Packages 5xx spike detected. Multiple workflows failing during install/publish steps. Affected: hotfix pipelines and emergency deploys. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/third-party-github-registry

kai_oncall: Oncall responding. Seeing lots of 502/503 from npm.pkg.github.com and token exchange errors from api.github.com. Pinging @mira_sre. :phone:

mira_sre: joining. Which jobs are failing? Any auth failures or purely registry 5xx?

sam_eng: failing steps: `install: npm ci` and `publish: npm publish`. Logs show: `GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/-/package/@redwood/core/dist-tags 502` and `POST https://api.github.com/_private/oauth/token 429` for some actions. So mixture of registry and auth rate limits.

olivia_platform: we have two hotfix branches blocked (hotfix/payments-urgent, hotfix/session-leak). Both require immediate deploy for customers under SLA. We're currently blocked from publishing packages and from actions re-running due to token errors.

nora_support: Customer-X is waiting on the payments hotfix. SLA window closes in ~40m. Please advise communications.

kai_oncall: Triage plan: 1) try to bypass package publish by pushing built artifact to our internal artifact mirror (Harbor) and to S3 as fallback. 2) if Actions token exchange is failing, attempt to run the deploy from our self-hosted runners which use a long-lived deploy key (less likely to hit oauth rate-limits). 3) open/support ticket to GitHub and enable status page monitoring. I'll start step 1 and spin up a self-hosted runner if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary for service-payments blocked 6a7 (publish step failed).

mira_sre: quick check: do our workflows already support ARTIFACT_URL fallback? I remember a prototype for ECR-based fallback earlier this year.

sam_eng: not in the hotfix workflows. We have a docker-image fallback for nightly builds but not for hotfix pipelines.

kai_oncall: executing manual build on an infra VM now, will push both a tarball to S3 and a docker image to ECR so deploy can consume whichever path is faster. Command I'm running:
```
# build and package
npm ci && npm run build && tar -czf dist.tar.gz dist/
# push artifact
aws s3 cp dist.tar.gz s3://redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix/payments/dist.tar.gz --acl private
# build docker image and push
docker build -t 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/payments:hotfix-payments-1994523456 .
aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
docker push 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/payments:hotfix-payments-1994523456
```

gha-bot: GitHub status: "Packages: Degraded Performance" (https://www.githubstatus.com) - incidents/9. Monitoring page for updates.

sam_eng: note: our deploy manifests can accept an image override via DEPLOY_IMAGE env var. I'll prepare a small workflow branch that sets DEPLOY_IMAGE to the ECR tag instead of relying on npm publish.

olivia_platform: if self-hosted runner helped, spinning one up now in our us-west pool. It uses a deploy key, not the short-lived OAUTH flow, so may avoid the 429s.

kai_oncall: pushed artifacts: S3 upload succeeded, docker push succeeded. Preparing branch `hotfix/payments-fallback-ecr` that sets DEPLOY_IMAGE and disables package publish. Patch pushed, triggering a manual workflow run via `gh workflow run`.

deploy-bot: Workflow run queued for hotfix/payments-fallback-ecr  run_id=8923121.

mira_sre: heads up for handoff: if the ECR image deploy works, we'll still need to keep S3 fallback for customers that require package-level hotfixes (some deploys unzip dist/ rather than run container). Also log GH support ticket reference.

kai_oncall: opened ticket with GitHub Support: internal ref GH-99910. Noted incidents/9 from status page.

nora_support: I've messaged Customer-X: "We're working a delivery workaround; root cause is degraded GitHub Packages. We'll update within 30m." Logged Zendesk ZD-46288.

sam_eng: deployment started using ECR image, canary initiated. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary progress: smoke checks running  run_id=8923121-step-canary.

kai_oncall: I'm seeing reduced failures on self-hosted runner attempts (fewer 429's), but public GH Actions still hit token limits. We'll keep self-hosted-enabled branch active for the next hour.

mira_sre: handoff incoming in 10m. Handoff notes (for whoever takes over): branch=hotfix/payments-fallback-ecr, ECR tag=hotfix-payments-1994523456, S3 artifact=s3://redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix/payments/dist.tar.gz, GH ticket=GH-99910, status page=https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/9, deploy run_id=8923121.

kai_oncall: handing off to @mira_sre (first_contact: 1994523456, handoff_ts: 1994523750). I'm stepping out briefly.

mira_sre: ack taking over. Continuing canary verification. Please leave any remaining logs in /var/log/ci/jobs/8923121 and tag me in the run.

nora_support: Customer-X ack'd update and will wait for final confirmation after canary.

mira_sre: canary smoke checks passed. Starting staged promotion to prod with manual gating. Monitoring metrics for error increase.

deploy-bot: Prod promotion initiated  run_id=8923122.

mira_sre: promotion looks healthy so far. GitHub status still reports degraded but static. We'll maintain deploy branch with fallback for 2 hours and then revert once GitHub is healthy.

sam_eng: follow-up action I'm adding: add `artifact_fallback` step to hotfix workflows that prefers DEPLOY_IMAGE or ARTIFACT_URL when set. Patch will include detection snippet:
```
if [ -n "$DEPLOY_IMAGE" ]; then
  echo "using image override"
  # skip package install/publish
else
  npm ci && npm run build
fi
```

olivia_platform: creating postmortem doc and action items: 1) implement fallback in all emergency workflows (owner: eng-platform), 2) add ECR/Harbor caching for packages (owner: eng-infra), 3) update runbook with self-hosted runner steps and handoff checklist (owner: eng-sre).

incident-bot: severity downgraded to Sev3 1: external dependency degraded but mitigated via fallback image and artifact store. Incident owner: mira_sre. Last update: 1994524120.

nora_support: Customer-X confirmed fix applied and will reopen if anything else pops up. Closing customer alert after 30m monitoring.

mira_sre: final notes for postmortem: timeline, root cause (GitHub Packages + token exchange rate-limits), mitigations (ECR image fallback, S3 artifact), ticket GH-99910, customer impact ZD-46288. Will circulate draft later today. :memo:
